note: sunfx=1 at tilt 90 went extinct on all four seeds. The suspect is not the mechanism but a documented interaction: slowing maturity by 1/sunlo means a founder in the dark takes up to 960 ticks to mature its first node, and the fragment cull gives a young body only `settle` = 1000 ticks to reach `minfrag` = 65. That is the minfrag/settle extinction cliff, which has now appeared three times on this branch in three different places -- anything that slows growth walks into it. Two ways out, tested separately: give the grace period the same 1/sunlo stretch the maturity got, or raise the floor so the dark is less dark. If neither revives it the mechanism is dead on its own terms.
